models_evaluated: 15 frontier AI chatbots (specific models not named in text)

links.outcome: Emergency under-triage rate of psychiatric emergencies (level D) from single-message disclosures
links.effect: Emergency under-triage in 23 of 410 level D trials (5.6%); all reassigned to level C. Accuracy highest for level D (94.3%), with marked over-triage of low and intermediate risk presentations.
links.quote: Emergency under-triage occurred in 23 of 410 level D trials (5.6%), and all under-triaged emergencies were reassigned to level C urgency.

links.outcome: Missed and unnecessary escalation in psychiatric triage by chatbots
links.effect: Emergency under-triage 5.6% (23/410 level D trials); mean signed ordinal error +0.47 levels indicating net over-triage; level B accuracy 19.7%.
links.quote: Mean signed ordinal error was positive (+0.47 triage levels), indicating net over-triage.

screen.reason: Evaluated 15 frontier LLM chatbots on emergency psychiatric triage using clinical vignettes across 4 triage urgency levels, without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
